# SNReady

> ServiceNow certification practice tests and exam preparation platform.

SNReady provides practice questions for ServiceNow certifications, generated from official Now Learning course content. All questions include detailed explanations with source citations.

## Quick Facts

- 1,300+ practice questions across 19 certifications
- Questions derived from official ServiceNow training materials
- Timed mock exams simulating real exam conditions
- Detailed explanations for every answer (correct and incorrect)
- Updated for Xanadu/Yokohama releases
- Pricing: $9/30 days (single cert) or $49 lifetime (all certs)

## Available Certifications

### Foundation
- [CSA - Certified System Administrator](https://snready.com/csa): Entry-level certification, 100+ practice questions
- [CAD - Certified Application Developer](https://snready.com/cad): Developer certification, 130+ practice questions

### Implementation Specialist (CIS)
- [CIS-DF - Data Foundations](https://snready.com/cis-df): CMDB, CSDM, data governance, 213 questions
- [CIS-ITSM - IT Service Management](https://snready.com/cis-itsm): Incident, Problem, Change management
- [CIS-CSM - Customer Service Management](https://snready.com/cis-csm): Case management, portals
- [CIS-FSM - Field Service Management](https://snready.com/cis-fsm): Work orders, scheduling
- [CIS-HR - Human Resources](https://snready.com/cis-hr): HR Service Delivery
- [CIS-Discovery](https://snready.com/cis-discovery): ITOM Discovery
- [CIS-SM - Service Mapping](https://snready.com/cis-sm): ITOM Service Mapping
- [CIS-EM - Event Management](https://snready.com/cis-em): ITOM Event Management
- [CIS-VR - Vulnerability Response](https://snready.com/cis-vr): SecOps
- [CIS-SIR - Security Incident Response](https://snready.com/cis-sir): SecOps
- [CIS-RC - Risk and Compliance](https://snready.com/cis-rc): GRC
- [CIS-TPRM - Third-Party Risk Management](https://snready.com/cis-tprm): GRC
- [CIS-SAM - Software Asset Management](https://snready.com/cis-sam): ITAM
- [CIS-HAM - Hardware Asset Management](https://snready.com/cis-ham): ITAM
- [CIS-SPM - Strategic Portfolio Management](https://snready.com/cis-spm): SPM

## Which Certification Should I Get?

By Role:
- ServiceNow Admin → CSA → CIS-ITSM
- Developer → CSA → CAD
- CMDB/Data → CSA → CIS-DF
- Security → CSA → CIS-VR or CIS-SIR
- HR → CSA → CIS-HR
- Field Service → CSA → CIS-FSM

Start with CSA — it's required for all other certifications.

## Sample Questions

**CSA:** Which security mechanism controls record-level access?
→ Answer: Access Control Lists (ACLs)

**CIS-DF:** What is the primary purpose of the CSDM?
→ Answer: Standardize service modeling

**CAD:** Which script runs server-side on record insert/update/delete?
→ Answer: Business Rule

See full questions with explanations at https://snready.com

## Why SNReady vs Exam Dumps

| Aspect | Exam Dumps | SNReady |
|--------|------------|---------|
| Source | Leaked questions | Official Now Learning content |
| Explanations | None | Detailed for every answer |
| Currency | Often outdated | Updated for current release |
| Risk | TOS violation | Zero risk |
| Learning | Memorization | Understanding |
